title: Meta Muse Spark Open is live on Together AI
gist: Together AI announces Day 0 availability of Meta's Muse Spark Open (816B total, 42B active per the model id), a 1M-context agentic coding model, with early-access endorsements from Factory and Ollama and serverless pricing of $1.25 input / $4.25 output per 1M tokens.

insights.claim: Together AI is a Day 0 launch partner for Meta's Muse Spark Open, which it describes as the most capable US open-weight model to date, built for long-running agentic coding that keeps entire codebases in context.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Neoclouds compete on day-0 access to major open-weight releases to win inference traffic.
insights.quote: the most capable US open-weight model to date

insights.claim: Together ran an early access program giving select customers the model before launch so they could prepare to serve it to their own customers on day 0 and feed back to Meta.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Pre-launch partner programs show how inference platforms embed themselves in model distribution.

insights.claim: Muse Spark Open offers a 1M-token context, long-horizon plan-act-observe-self-correct behavior with subagent coordination, computer use across desktop/mobile/browser, multimodal text/image/audio/audio-video input and intent commentary before actions.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: A broad agent-oriented feature set makes the model a candidate for coding-agent products.

insights.claim: Intent commentary, where the model states what it is doing and why before acting, is pitched as making long agent runs easier to audit.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Auditability may matter for enterprise adoption of autonomous agents.
insights.quote: which makes long runs easier to audit

insights.claim: Factory says Muse Spark Open consistently selected the right tool and kept responses compact in its agentic engineering workflows, and Factory serves it to customers from day 0.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Early production-agent vendor endorses tool-selection quality, a key metric for coding agents.
insights.quote: consistently selected the right tool and kept its responses compact

insights.claim: Ollama reports the model performs particularly well on tool calling and long context, including multi-step and parallel calls with clean structured outputs, and offers it from day 0 in partnership with Together AI.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Distribution through Ollama widens developer reach for open-weight models.
insights.quote: multi-step and parallel calls with clean structured outputs

insights.claim: Together lists Muse Spark Open serverless at $1.25 per 1M input tokens, $4.25 per 1M output tokens and $0.15 per 1M cached input tokens, served under model id meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Benchmark price for a frontier-class open-weight coding model on a neocloud; use to track token price compression.
